 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # Marker is the long straight/cross-shaped component. Its color is applied to largest non-background object.
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
       if grid[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
       col=grid[r][c]; st=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
       while st:
        y,x=st.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
        for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
         yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
         if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==col:
          seen.add((yy,xx)); st.append((yy,xx))
       comps.append((col,cells))
    marker=max(comps,key=lambda z:len(z[1]))
    marker_color=marker[0]
    # in these puzzles the conspicuous largest shape is target; exclude components that are straight bars/markers
    candidates=[]
    for col,cells in comps:
      if col==bg or len(cells)<4: continue
      rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
      # retain compact, non-linear shape components; long bar markers have a one-cell dimension
      if min(max(rs)-min(rs)+1,max(cs)-min(cs)+1)>1:
       candidates.append((len(cells),col,cells))
    if candidates:
      _,old,cells=max(candidates)
      out=[row[:] for row in grid]
      for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=marker_color
      return out
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
"
}
